description: Check one more FF-output skip before switching tensors
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,590 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000-point margin. There have been 65 prior macro-attempts and 548 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0166/micro-0006 at 1,590/99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0167/micro-0001, where FF-output pair 180/59 scored 98.96% at 1,589. Three measured FF-output sensitive pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: one further skip may reopen the qualifying band; if its first pair also fails, two consecutive no-accept macros define a bounded local plateau. The helper adds one nearest eligible union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than switching now because it applies the same replication-based stopping criterion that previously avoided a false QKV plateau.
summary: The FF-output plateau check evaluated five ordered unions. Four qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,590 to 1,586 parameters; micro-0005 proposed 1,585, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 4 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used five official migrations/verifications over about 6m20s. Stop reason: first scored discard; the proposed two-empty-band plateau was falsified.
